example_output.title: Show HN: x402 Bazaar – AI agents pay for APIs with USDC
example_output.first_comment:
I've been working on this for 3 months. The core insight: AI agents should be able to pay for external APIs themselves, without human intervention.

How it works: The x402 protocol uses HTTP 402 (Payment Required) status code. When an agent calls an API, the server responds with payment instructions. The agent signs a USDC transfer on Base blockchain. The server verifies on-chain, then executes and returns the result.

Real numbers: 74 APIs live, 164 payments processed, 5 external providers registered, 19 USDC earned by builders, 99.9% uptime. All on-chain, all verifiable.

Try it: https://x402bazaar.org or npx x402-bazaar init

Happy to discuss the technical trade-offs, regulatory questions, or architectural decisions.
